text: At Hartwell Regional Utilities, the Beginner project solved a narrower problem: Security Analyst Mara Voss hardened a handful of servers and shipped one Sentinel rule, for IT Manager Dale Granger. This project starts the moment Hartwell decides the basics aren't enough.

Two people ask for a much bigger buildout the same week. IT Director Owen Mercer wants real operational visibility across Windows, Linux, and the perimeter firewall. Compliance Officer Renee Castellano wants an auditable compliance trail, the kind utilities need for frameworks like NERC CIP.

Owen and Renee didn't coordinate before asking, but their requests overlap more than either expected. Real multi-source visibility, built with real documentation and a real incident-response runbook, satisfies both asks at once.
This project builds multi-source log ingestion into Sentinel, a real cross-source correlation rule, a Conditional Access pilot policy, and Hartwell's first real incident-response runbook.
Next lesson reconciles exactly what Owen and Renee each need, before any of that gets built.
